cl.x: Provide Sika® Showerbond where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (January 2025, Version 05.01).

Sika® Showerbond is a solvent based, fast grab, gun grade adhesive. It has been specifically formulated for bonding acrylic plastic shower linings to unpainted gypsum plasterboard, fibre cement sheeting and timber.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Sika® Showerbond is used for bonding acrylic plastic shower linings to suitable wall linings and bonding acrylic shower trays to suitable flooring.
Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (January 2025, Version 05.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
cl.x: Ensure both surfaces to be bonded are clean, dry and grease free. Cut nozzle on cartridge as shown below so that a 5-6 mm bead will be extruded.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (January 2025, Version 05.01) and the requirements below.

s: Yield: On average, one cartridge of Sika® Showerbond will supply approx. 12 metres of 5mm x 5mm bead
Curing rate: ~ 24 hours @ 20°C
Skinning time: 1 minute
r: On average, one cartridge of Sika® Showerbond will supply approx. 12 metres of 5mm x 5mm bead

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools
s: Relocation time: Up to 30 minutes, depending on temperature and ventilation
Apply a 5-6 mm bead in vertical lines at 100 mm centres onto substrate, and apply continuous bead within 15 mm of the perimeter line of the shower lining.
Place shower lining onto wall within 10 minutes and firmly press the entire sheet with your hands so that full contact is made with all beads of adhesive.
Brace the lining as required in the shower manufacturer's installation instructions.
Bracing if required should remain in position for not less than 18 hours. The shower should not be used for at least 24 hours after the wall lining has been installed.
Do not apply blobs of adhesive. These will cause unsightly undulations and buckles in the sheet.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Clean up using a dry clean cloth or Sika® Remover-208.

s: Not recommended for immersion, exposure to sunlight or exterior use
Do not use below 5°C
Do not use to adhere acrylic plastic shower linings to painted, sealed or any non-porous wall linings
Cure is by solvent release (flammable solvents are released during cure)
